label: Six of the seven non-updater doctor commands gain from the shared environment (speckit, runtime-mirrors, skill-advisor, env, mcp, git standards subset); deep-loop gains only for DOC-368 because its other scenarios require empty or specially populated graph states.

Exactly 23 existing scenario files plus 4 READMEs change: 12+README in system-spec-kit (DOC-349/350/352-361), 4 in system-skill-advisor (348/362/363/366), 1+README in system-deep-loop (368), 3+README in sk-git (371-373), 3+README in mcp-code-mode (375-377). DOC-351/364/365/367/369/374 are already copy-free.

DOC-370 must keep a disposable clone: it writes local Git config and a linked worktree resolves config and hooks to the shared common Git dir (verified with git rev-parse --git-path config/hooks), so using the fixture would mutate the main checkout's config and hook state.

Create DOC-379 doctor-mcp-unknown-flag.md (install --server and debug --bogus rejected pre-YAML with unknown_flag, cross-sub-action kept) and DOC-380 doctor-update-environment.md (shared environment lifecycle and rollback reset contract).

Ordered plan: contract fixes first (speckit advisory + enum, DOC-349/350, mcp unknown_flag + DOC-379), then build the local numbered worktree and fixtures, record and commit the base, then migrate the 27 files plus DOC-380, then verify with scoped dry-run-first actions and a rollback to a clean baseline; never push the fixture branch.
